# Today we are going to be practicing using factors and graphing intertidal data!

### The first step is loading in our libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor) # This will help clean up the column names
```

### The next critical step is reading in our data

```{r}
intertidal <- read_csv(here("Week_09", "Data", "intertidaldata.csv"))

intertidaldata_latitude <- read_csv(here("Week_09", "Data", "intertidaldata_latitude.csv"))

intertidal_data_dictionary <- read_csv(here("Week_09", "Data", "intertidal_data_dictionary.csv"))
```

As you'll notice, I loaded in all three csv files but for the sake of this assignment, I will only be using the intertidal data set and not the latitude intertidal data set.

### The third step is cleaning up the data

```{r}
cleaned_intertidal <- intertidal |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(quadrat = str_remove(quadrat, "\\s*[.1]+$")) |> # This gets rid of the two unique input names "Low ." and "Mid 1" and replaces with just "Low" and "Mid" --> Had to google the specific symbols, not sure if there is another way to do this
  mutate(quadrat = factor(quadrat, levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High")),  
         site = factor(site))

cleaned_intertidal
```

### The fourth step is summarizing the bare rock percent cover statistics during differing tide heights for each site

```{r}
summary_by_site <- cleaned_intertidal |>
  group_by(site, quadrat) |> # Grouping for site and tide height
  summarise(
    mean_cover = mean(bare_rock, na.rm = TRUE), # Mean % cover only for Bare Rock
    .groups = "drop" # Removing groupings structures so left with dataframe
  )

summary_by_site
```

### The final step is graphing these summary statistics

```{r}
#| label: fig-barerock-cover
#| fig-cap: "Percent Cover (%) of Bare Rock During Various Tide Levels at Each Location"
#| fig-cap-location: bottom
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-align: "center"

summary_by_site |>
  ggplot(aes(x = quadrat, y = mean_cover,
             group = site,
             color = fct_reorder2(site, quadrat, mean_cover))) + # Reordering site by % cover values at max quadrat (High)
  geom_line(size = .75) + 
  geom_point(alpha = .75) +
  scale_y_continuous( # Added this to help identify the value of each point
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 10), 
    minor_breaks = seq(0, 100, 5) # Adds minor gridlines 
  ) +
  labs(x = "Tide Level", y = "Average Percent Cover (%) of Bare Rock",
       caption = "Data provided by Professor Silbiger",
       color = "Site"
  ) + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", vjust = -1),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", vjust = 2),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
  
```
